title: Reading Drill — Measuring a pond's change in level — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Measuring a pond's change in level — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The park ecologist in Elmbrook received an old report about still water on the shore hiding a slow rise. The report compared water depth beside the outlet, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the a gauge board rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered four weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include recent watering nearby. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed readings at fixed intervals as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
